Background: the grand marble staircase of an opera house with standard-height steps, a waist-high carved balustrade, chandeliers and warm daylight from tall windows, harsh direct strobe, body muscle definition emphasis, luxury opulent mood, sophisticated elegant atmosphere, high-end editorial, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly in view. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
